how_to_apply: Willing and eligible employees may send applications in the enclosed proforma through proper channel.
Attach NOC, attested APARs ratings for the last five years, and vigilance/D&AR clearance.
Super scribe the envelope with 'Application for the Post of ________ against Vacancy Notice No. ________'.
Send the application to GENERAL MANAGER (HR), DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306.
Make sure it reaches by 27 November 2026.
important_instructions: Cut-off date for age and eligibility would be reckoned as on closing date of vacancy notice. Applications received with incomplete information will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers/employees of Indian Railways, Central/State Govt, or PSUs Age limit: Maximum 55 years (as on closing date of vacancy notice) Other conditions: Command over working on computer (MS-word, Excel, Power point). Desirable: The officer/employee should have experience of SAP/HRMS.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Parent pay plus deputation allowance and other perks and allowances as per DFCCIL policy. 3 years extendable to 5 years (subject to exemption by DPE from the rule of immediate absorption)

content_sections.heading: How Will DFCCIL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications through proper channel Verification of APARs and vigilance clearance

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: NOC Attested APARs ratings for the last five years Vigilance/D&AR clearance Certificate advising requisite information in respect of the employee

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DFCCIL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Willing and eligible employees may send applications in the enclosed proforma through proper channel. Attach NOC, attested APARs ratings for the last five years, and vigilance/D&AR clearance. Super scribe the envelope with 'Application for the Post of ________ against Vacancy Notice No. ________'. Send the application to GENERAL MANAGER (HR), DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306. Make sure it reaches by 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Cut-off date for age and eligibility would be reckoned as on closing date of vacancy notice. Applications received with incomplete information will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DFCCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DFCCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Manager / Assistant Manager / Jr. Manager (HR).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DFCCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma enclosed with vacancy notice) and send it to GENERAL MANAGER (HR), DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306, by through proper channel, to reach by 27 November 2026.
